description: HIT 课程资料族配置。课程代码和培养方案记录保持独立；为提高长期可维护性，顺序课、语言/等级变体及相近课程可共享一个资料仓库。运行期不重新执行启发式，配置中的成员关系是唯一权威输入。

policy.name_normalization: NFKC; casefold; normalize punctuation; remove sequence, language and level suffixes; normalize conjunctions
policy.similarity: maximum of normalized edit ratio, character-bigram Jaccard and containment ratio
policy.domain_gate: same primary offering college or shared course-code subject prefix
policy.component_rule: undirected connected components after the approved-candidate stage
policy.repo_id_strategy: prefer a legacy-bound or already-explicit member repository, otherwise the case-insensitive first member repo_id
policy.family_id_strategy: sha256 of the stable target repo_id; membership changes do not rename the family
